derivations: channels: cropped from 64 to 8 (FC3, FC4, C3, C1, Cz, C2, C4, CPz); chunk row i is channel i
channel names: trailing dots stripped and case normalized to the 10-10 convention (Fc3. -> FC3)
units: EDF physical dimension 'uV' read from the header; values stored in uV as float64 (MNE reads volts; scaled back by 1e6 and snapped to the file's physical resolution)
sample rate: 160 Hz as recorded; not resampled
events: EDF+ annotations T1 -> cue_left_fist, T2 -> cue_right_fist, T0 -> rest, associated by onset sample
duration: each run cropped to its first 42 s (test fixture only)
source.subject: S001
source.warning: Public dataset, not recorded on OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy; one subject, ~22 trials per class

timing.notes: EDF import: no per-sample timestamps or sequence counters exist; sample time is index / 160 Hz from the start of each run's file. Gaps cannot be detected from stored data.
